scope: Bounded public DU pre-candidate freeze; not a module/native rerun or full gate

readinessMeaning.callable: Assertion function frozen; cannot execute until admission and real installed/moved module loads are authenticated
readinessMeaning.staged-types: Exact TypeScript bytes frozen as data; no candidate compilation performed
readinessMeaning.blocked-spec: Concrete case frozen; executor requires missing root mapping or supervisor implementation; never a pass or skip

cases.assertion: Root and explicit DU subpath expose all three factories; both entries produce single-command du definitions and the du-commands plugin.

Authenticate inputs before scripts; build and pack immutable candidate; install tarball into a real consumer; physically rename consumer; remove original location; compile and execute only after move. Authenticate tarball, installed tree and actual module bytes.

Isolated packaged negative control deletes explicit ./commands/du export: runtime import and positive strict consumer must fail for missing public export, never fall back to dist/source paths. Keep mutation separate from candidate evidence.
Isolated source-fallback control points an entry outside moved package or to src; preflight/load proof rejects it, even if import could otherwise succeed. No workspace/tsx/path-alias rescue.
Absent root/subpath resolution, missing module-load records, unexpected URL or changed evaluated source bytes fails acceptance. A correct on-disk hash without load records never suffices.

Before execution reject wrong candidate/freeze/source/fixture/supervisor/tool identity; reject incomplete selected-source inventory; postcheck catches changes, removals AND new entries. Archive policy excludes unrelated live edits without overlaying them.
Strict NodeNext installed/moved consumer imports root/subpath factories and DuCommandsOptions/DuLimits, all nine declared limits, readonly command definitions and plugin types.
Both root and explicit-subpath factories reject an unknown options field; require the designated TS2353 diagnostics, not missing-module failures.
DuLimits numeric option rejects a string, with the designated TS2322 diagnostic; no any, assertion or expect-error escape.
createDuCommands result rejects push with TS2339; negative compilation must not be satisfied by unrelated errors.
Once root binds aggregate DU property, positive aggregate limits compile and nested replace/unknown DU options fail; top-level replace remains the sole replacement policy.
requires: exact aggregateDuOptions declaration and property path

cases.assertion: createAgentCommands returns unique EXACT root-approved 75 names, including du and html-to-markdown; excludes getopts, curl, safejs and expr. Exact name equality, not count alone.
Actual Shell.use(agentCommands()) resolves plugin readiness and registers the identical exact inventory; getopts executes as a builtin without registry count growth.

Run isolated default-list negative controls: 74 names, 76 names, a duplicate at length75, and an unapproved substitution at length75 all fail the same exact-name guard. These are guard controls, not new product cohorts.
Standalone duCommands collision rejects without changing sentinel; replace:true intentionally replaces it and runs public du --help.
Actual aggregate setup with existing du sentinel preflights collision without partial registration; top-level replace:true installs all75 and replaces sentinel.
Root-bound aggregate DU maxEntries=1 rejects a two-entry apparent walk while standalone default succeeds; assert exact bound status/bytes, not merely an arbitrary failure.

Two separate one-entry DU invocations both succeed with family maxEntries=1; restrictive DU limits do not restrict another root-selected family, and that family's limits do not become a shared DU/shell budget.
requires: root-selected other-family control and exact outcome

cases.assertion: Actual Memory VFS file with known logical size but absent allocatedBytes fails allocation mode, prints no numeric row and emits exact root-bound required diagnostic; never silently treats unknown as zero or size.

Explicit test-provider stat wrapper reports allocatedBytes=0 for a seven-byte file: allocation output is zero and apparent output is seven. This is a synthetic provider assertion, not native physical usage.
requires: installed public MemoryFileSystem/Shell and DU plugin

cases.assertion: Public apparent-size walk over reverse-ordered Memory listing prints A then z then directory total; separate operands retain z then A order. Directory own logical contribution is zero. O060 duplicate operands remains a disclosed gap, not exercised/rescored.
Real Shell du metadata walk piped to head -n0 naturally closes its enrolled output operation and stops cooperative metadata admission without aborting caller or unrelated work.
Real public first-consumer-read close/cancel during cooperative metadata work closes only DU output scope, drains admitted work, and does not force-cancel opaque providers.
Invalid DU option plus closed stdout still validates on original caller and preserves required stderr; exact mapping and precedence must be root-bound.
Through public invocation observation, cleanup registration precedes operation acquisition/metadata admission, closes new admission and covers admitted cooperative work exactly once.
Account stdout via DU budget then awaited operation output; withheld cooperative write blocks progress and settlement until release/close; stderr stays caller-owned and correctly accounted.
Public exec settlement awaits shared idempotent cooperative close, including finally; synchronous metadata walk completion alone is not resource-closure proof.

Overlapping explicit caller cancellation/dispose/finally drains the same admitted cooperative resources once; preserve original caller reason where contract requires; no whole-caller abort used to fake output close.
Closing DU stdout leaves independently owned sibling work/caller usable; opaque-provider late rejection is observed but no forced preemption or arbitrary settlement deadline is promised.
